name: Absolute Evasion
short:
An evasion with lengthy
invulnerability time, also
sheathing your weapon.
full:
Perform a corkscrew-like evasion,
providing a window of opportunity to make
an emergency escape. Sports a lengthy
period of invulnerability and sheathes
your weapon automatically upon use.

name: Absolute Readiness
short:
Evade with your weapon drawn,
restoring Sharpness, reloading
ammo, and applying phial coating.
full:
Perform a corkscrew-like evasion. In
addition to a lengthy invulnerability window,
Sharpness is restored, ammo refilled, and
phial coating applied. Once triggered, you
automatically unsheathe your weapon.

name: Heal Gain
short:
Temporarily improves Health
recovery effects and Natural
Recovery speed.
full:
A moment of concentration bolsters
your own healing abilities. For a limited
time, Health recovery is more effective,
and temporary damage taken during
combat recovers more quickly.

name: Escape Runner
short:
Stops Stamina depletion tempor-
arily when running away from
enemies or transporting items.
full:
Briefly stops Stamina depletion while
running away from large monsters
and dashing while transporting items.
This boost of adrenaline only lasts
a short amount of time.

name: Hunter's Oasis
short:
Places a special healing
device on the ground that
restores Health within range.
full:
Places a special device on the ground
that emits a Health-restoring mist. It will
continue to restore your Health as long
as you are within range.

name: Mass Combiner
short:
Quickly boosts Combo success
rate for a set time, making
mass combos feasible.
full:
A technique conceived by a famous Gunner
that improves your success at combining
items, and ensures you produce the max
number possible per combination. As it's
mentally taxing, the effects are temporary.

name: Frenzy Fever
short:
Infects you with Frenzy.
Use with extreme caution.
full:
Science once again goes a step too far
with the invention of a medicine that will
give you the Frenzy virus. There's probably
someone out there willing to try it... Um,
that someone isn't you, is it?

name: Castle Walls
short:
Medicine that temporarily
raises Defense. Unable to
dash while in effect.
full:
Medicine that makes your body as hard
as steel, raising your Defense. While in
effect, damage taken is reduced and
attacks won't knock you back, but you'll
be unable to dash for its duration.

name: Fortress Walls
short:
Medicine that temporarily
raises Defense, but makes you
unable to dash or evade.
full:
Medicine that makes your body as hard as
diamond, greatly raising Defense. You'll take
less damage and be impervious to abnormal
statuses and blowbacks, but you won't
be able to dash or evade for its duration.

name: Arisen Phoenix
short:
Removes all status effects
and heals Health based
on amount removed.
full:
Purifies the body and returns it to its
natural state. Good, bad, it doesn't matter
-- all status effects are wiped clean
and your Health is healed in proportion
to the effects removed.

name: Ground Slash I
short:
Scrapes your Great Sword
along the ground, producing
a massive shock wave.
full:
Scrapes your Great Sword on the ground
before rushing forward and unleashing a
big shock wave. Get both the initial swing
and the shock wave to hit your target and
you'll mete out massive damage.

name: Ground Slash II
short:
Scrapes your Great Sword
along the ground, producing
a massive shock wave.
full:
Tier II has a more powerful shock wave
that can impact multiple monsters.

name: Ground Slash III
short:
Scrapes your Great Sword
along the ground, producing
a massive shock wave.
full:
Tier III has the most powerful shock wave,
which can knock back multiple monsters.

name: Lion's Maw I
short:
Slashes at the enemies in
front of you and bolsters
the next strike's Attack.
full:
Swings your Great Sword around your body
with bloodthirsty force and raises the Attack
of the following strike. This hellish Art leaves
hunters with a demonic look in their eyes...
and the battlefield littered with corpses.

name: Lion's Maw II
short:
Slashes at the enemies in
front of you and bolsters
the next strike's Attack.
full:
Tier II raises the Attack of your
next strike even higher.

name: Lion's Maw III
short:
Slashes at the enemies in
front of you and bolsters
the next strike's Attack.
full:
Tier III raises the Attack of your
next strike even higher than Tier II.

name: Brimstone Slash I
short:
Builds up power and slices
in the direction you face.
Counterattack if hit.
full:
Builds up power with great fury, releasing
a ground-splitting slash in the direction you
choose. If you get attacked while using this
Art, you'll absorb the hit, and then execute
a deadly counterattack.

name: Brimstone Slash II
short:
Builds up power and slices
in the direction you face.
Counterattack if hit.
full:
Tier II builds up more power
before unleashing the slash.

name: Brimstone Slash III
short:
Builds up power and slices
in the direction you face.
Counterattack if hit.
full:
Tier III builds up even more power
than Tier II before unleashing the slash.

name: Moonbreaker I
short:
Leap up into the air, then use the
weight of your Great Sword to
deliver a fierce downward slash.
full:
Leap into the air, then twist your body to channel
all the energy into a downward slash. Uses the
sword's weight to break body parts.

name: Moonbreaker II
short:
Leap up into the air, then use the
weight of your Great Sword to
deliver a fierce downward slash.
full:
Tier II puts more power into the
downward slash.

name: Moonbreaker III
short:
Leap up into the air, then use the
weight of your Great Sword to
deliver a fierce downward slash.
full:
Tier III puts even more power into the
downward slash than Tier II.

name: Sword Dance I
short:
A flurry of five sword slashes.
Useful for dealing elemental
damage to hard body parts.
full:
Slashes your sword five times in a
graceful, dance-like sequence. This
Art is useful for dealing elemental damage
to hard body parts, as you may continue
attacking even if a hit is repelled.

name: Sword Dance II
short:
A flurry of seven sword slashes.
Useful for dealing elemental
damage to hard body parts.
full:
Tier II allows you to slash
a total of seven times.

name: Sword Dance III
short:
A flurry of nine sword slashes.
Useful for dealing elemental
damage to hard body parts.
full:
Tier III allows you to slash
a total of nine times.

name: Round Force I
short:
A wide sweep of your blade,
slashing through targets.
Invulnerable for its duration.
full:
A spin attack that slashes all targets
surrounding you. During execution,
you'll be invulnerable to monster
attacks, making it an effective
evasive technique as well.

name: Round Force II
short:
A wide sweep of your blade,
slashing through targets.
Invulnerable for its duration.
full:
Tier II has a wider-
ranging spin attack.

name: Round Force III
short:
A wide sweep of your blade
slashes foes and sends allies
skyward. Grants invulnerability.
full:
Tier III has the same range as Tier
II, but also lifts your allies into the air.

name: Shoryugeki I
short:
Smashes shield upwards after
a slash attack. Fierce enough
to Stun if it hits a head.
full:
After landing a slice attack, you thrust
your shield into the air in an uppercut
motion. A popular fighting move, the
follow-up attack with your shield is
strong enough to even Stun monsters.

name: Shoryugeki II
short:
Smashes shield upwards after
a slash attack for two more hits.
Fierce enough to Stun.
full:
Tier II adds an extra hit to the
shield bash, turning it into a
strong two-hit combo.

name: Shoryugeki III
short:
Smashes shield upwards after
a slash attack for three more
hits. Fierce enough to Stun.
full:
Tier III adds another extra hit to the
shield bash, turning it into a fierce
three-hit combo.

name: Chaos Oil I
short:
Charges forward and applies effects
of all other oils to your blade. Can
be used along with existing oils.
full:
Charges forward and coats your blade in a special
mixture that ignites on friction with your shield. Combines
the effects of all other oils, purely because some lazy
hunter didn't want to apply them one by one. Can be
used in combination with the existing oils.

name: Chaos Oil II
short:
Charges forward and applies
effects of all other oils to your blade.
Lasts longer than Tier I.
full:
Tier II's more stable mixture
lasts longer than in Tier I.

name: Chaos Oil III
short:
Charges forward and applies effects
of all other oils to your blade.
Effects are stronger than in Tier I.
full:
The effects of the oil in Tier III are
stronger compared to Tier I.

unlock.title: A Tragedy in Silver and Gold

name: Spinning Meteor I
short:
Waves your Hammer around
in a large arc for a series
of hits and a final smash.
full:
The powers of gravity and centrifugal force
combine in a series of powerful, spinning
Hammer attacks. The final blow is the most
powerful, so time it carefully to land a hit
right between a monster's eyes.

name: Spinning Meteor II
short:
Waves your Hammer around
in a large arc for a series
of hits and a final smash.
full:
Tier II features more power behind
each of the Hammer blows.

name: Spinning Meteor III
short:
Waves your Hammer around
in a large arc for a series
of hits and a final smash.
full:
Tier III features even more force
behind each of the Hammer blows
than in Tier II.

name: Provoke I
short:
Taunts monsters, raising
chances of being targeted
by them temporarily.
full:
A taunt where you make yourself known
by raising your weapon up in the air,
momentarily upping the likelihood of
monsters targeting you. The effect will
wear off early if you leave the area.

name: Provoke II
short:
Taunts monsters, raising chances of
being targeted by them temporarily.
Also raises Defense.
full:
The Taunt effect lasts longer
in Tier II. Also raises Defense.

name: Provoke III
short:
Raises chances of monsters
targeting you while also
increasing Attack.
full:
The Taunt effect lasts just as long
as in Tier II, but you also get a boost
to your Attack.

name: Typhoon Trigger I
short:
Press the X Button while
spinning to unleash a
powerful uppercut.
full:
A spinning Hammer attack that takes
a few swings to get going. Press the
X Button while spinning to unleash a
sharp uppercut. Forget to press the
X Button and you will stumble.

name: Typhoon Trigger II
short:
Press the X Button while
spinning to uppercut. More
spins means more power.
full:
Tier II's final uppercut smash
is stronger than in Tier I.

name: Typhoon Trigger III
short:
Press the X Button while
spinning to uppercut. More
spins means more power.
full:
Tier III's final uppercut smash is
even stronger than in Tier II.

name: Impact Press I
short:
Adds a shockwave attack to
Charged Attack I - III for a
limited period.
full:
Adds a shockwave to Charged Attacks by focusing
your spirit. The shockwave is formed when air rushes
into the vacuum created by raising the hammer quickly
after the moment of impact.

name: Impact Press II
short:
Adds a shockwave attack to
Charged Attack I - III for a
limited period.
full:
Adds shockwaves to Charged Attacks
for a longer period than in Tier I.

name: Impact Press III
short:
Adds a shockwave attack to
Charged Attack I - III for a
limited period.
full:
Adds shockwaves to Charged Attacks
for a longer period than in Tier II.

name: Shield Assault I
short:
Raises your shield to charge
monsters while blocking. Keep
pressing to thrust attack.
full:
A powerful charging shield attack that
serves to defend even as you rush forward.
Use this Art to close the distance between
you and the monster, or to evade. Can be
chained into other thrust attacks as well.

name: Shield Assault II
short:
Raises your shield to charge
monsters while blocking. Keep
pressing to thrust attack.
full:
Tier II allows you to charge
a longer distance.

name: Shield Assault III
short:
Raises your shield to charge
monsters while blocking. Keep
pressing to thrust attack.
full:
Tier III allows you to charge even
farther than in Tier II.

name: Corkscrew Jab I
short:
Raises your Lance and
builds up power for a
drilling thrust attack.
full:
Focuses your energy into a powerful
drilling Lance attack. While you're
defenseless during the charge up phase,
the power dealt -- if you manage
to connect -- is considerable.

name: Corkscrew Jab II
short:
Raises your Lance and
builds up power for a
drilling thrust attack.
full:
Tier II takes longer to charge,
but the power of the thrust is
proportionately stronger.

name: Corkscrew Jab III
short:
Raises your Lance and
builds up power for a
drilling thrust attack.
full:
Tier III takes longer to charge
than in Tier II, but the power of
the thrust is even stronger.

name: Enraged Guard I
short:
Raises your shield to take an
attack. Block stronger strikes
to absorb more power.
full:
Raises your shield to block an incoming
attack. When doing so, the power of the
hit will be absorbed, raising your Attack.
Risky to use, but the more powerful the
blow, the more your Attack will increase.

name: Enraged Guard II
short:
Raises your shield to take an
attack. Block stronger strikes
to absorb even more power.
full:
Upon a successful block, Tier II
raises your Attack higher than in
Tier I.

name: Enraged Guard III
short:
Raises your shield to take
an attack. Absorbed power
fluctuates by attack.
full:
Upon a successful block, Tier III
raises your Attack even higher
than in Tier II.

name: Healing Shield I
short:
Coats your shield with medicine
that restores Health over an area
when blocking attacks.
full:
An Art inspired by Oils and Healing Phials. Coats
the Shield with a medicinal balm; when an attack
is blocked, the medicine is scattered, restoring
your Health and that of nearby allies.

name: Healing Shield II
short:
Coats your shield with medicine that
restores Health over an area when
blocking attacks. Effect lasts longer.
full:
The healing effect lasts longer
than in Tier I.

name: Healing Shield III
short:
Coats your shield with medicine that
restores Health over an area when
blocking attacks. Effects are stronger.
full:
Restores more Health and lasts longer
than in Tier II.

name: Super Nova I
short:
Fire special Pierce Shot that
triggers a wide-ranging
midair explosion.
full:
An attack that uses specialized piercing
ammo which travels a short distance before
exploding midair. The blast is quite
powerful, but if the ammo hits a wall
or floor, it won't explode.

name: Super Nova II
short:
Fire special Pierce Shot that
triggers a wide-ranging
midair explosion.
full:
Tier II has a more powerful explosion,
but takes more time to fire.

name: Super Nova III
short:
Fire special Pierce Shot that
triggers a wide-ranging
midair explosion.
full:
Tier III has an even more powerful
explosion than Tier II, but takes a
longer time to fire.

name: Guns Blazing I
short:
Temporarily boosts movement
and reload speed, and reduces
gunfire recoil impact.
full:
A revolutionary technique that fires
a canister above your head that
showers you with a special stimulant.
Boosts your movement and reload
speeds, and also reduces recoil.

name: Guns Blazing II
short:
Temporarily boosts movement
and reload speed, and reduces
gunfire recoil impact.
full:
In Tier II, the movement speed, reload
speed, and recoil effects last longer.

name: Guns Blazing III
short:
Temporarily boosts movement
and reload speed, and reduces
gunfire recoil impact.
full:
In Tier III, the movement speed, reload
speed, and recoil effects last even
longer than in Tier II.

name: Gunpowder Infusion I
short:
Increases Heavy Bowgun
firepower for a set
number of shots.
full:
Loads special gunpowder into your
Bowgun, increasing the power of your
ammo for a set number of shots. Discovered
by accident when a newbie Hunter loaded
some lava rocks into their weapon...

name: Gunpowder Infusion II
short:
Increases Heavy Bowgun
firepower for a set
number of shots.
full:
Tier II loads more gunpowder,
allowing for more empowered shots.

name: Gunpowder Infusion III
short:
Increases Heavy Bowgun
firepower for a set
number of shots.
full:
Tier III loads more gunpowder than in
Tier II, allowing for an even higher
number of empowered shots.

name: Void Piercer I
short:
Loads an iron loading pin into
the Heavy Bowgun and fires it
at the target.
full:
Shoots an iron spike from the Heavy Bowgun.
By igniting gunpowder, the resulting pressure launches
the red-hot loading pin, which rips through the air and
deals Cutting damage. Firing becomes safer if a shield
is attached.

name: Void Piercer II
short:
Loads an iron loading pin into
the Heavy Bowgun and fires it
at the target.
full:
Discharges more gunpowder resulting in
more damage dealt when compared to Tier I.

unlock.title: Sky Tribe: Savior of the Skyway

name: Void Piercer III
short:
Loads an iron loading pin into
the Heavy Bowgun and fires it
at the target.
full:
Discharges as much gunpowder as
possible resulting in more damage
dealt when compared to Tier II.

name: Bullet Geyser I
short:
Backsteps, firing a timed
explosive into the ground and
sending you further backwards.
full:
After an initial backstep, fires a
timed explosive onto the ground,
the discharge sending you even
further back. This Art works both
as an attack and evasive technique.

name: Bullet Geyser II
short:
Backsteps, firing a timed
explosive into the ground and
sending you further backwards.
full:
Tier II features a higher
number of explosions
than in Tier I.

name: Bullet Geyser III
short:
Backsteps, firing a timed
explosive into the ground and
sending you further backwards.
full:
Tier III features an even higher
number of explosions than in Tier II.

name: Full House I
short:
Loads all non-Rapid Fire
ammo into your weapon
with a single reload.
full:
An Art passed down by a Gunner
from a certain region. Reloads all the
ammo you have on you, save for
Specialized Rapid Fire ammo, in a
single motion.

name: Full House II
short:
Loads all non-Rapid Fire
ammo into your weapon
with a single reload.
full:
Tier II allows you to reload in
an even shorter amount of time.

name: Full House III
short:
Loads all ammo into your
weapon with a single reload,
including Rapid Fire ammo.
full:
Tier III reloads in the same
amount of time as Tier II, but
also reloads Rapid Fire ammo.

name: Rapid Fire Rain I
short:
Fires a specialized ammo at
high speed until it runs out or
you press the B Button to stop.
full:
An Art that relies on special bullets
that split up inside your weapon, giving
you unprecedented rapid firing speeds.
Autofires until the chamber empties, or
you press the B Button to cancel.

name: Rapid Fire Rain II
short:
Fires a specialized ammo at
high speed until it runs out or
you press the B Button to stop.
full:
Tier II allows you to
fire more ammo.

name: Rapid Fire Rain III
short:
Fires a specialized ammo at
high speed until it runs out or
you press the B Button to stop.
full:
Tier III allows you to
fire even more ammo
than in Tier II.

unlock.title: A Man's Arena is His Castle

name: Charge Shot I
short:
Can fire up to five charged
Normal S Lv1 rounds. Charge by
holding the A Button.
full:
Charges up the power of Normal S Lv1 ammo.
Special gunpowder used in the Light Bowgun's
chamber catalyzes with the rounds, resulting in a
controlled increase in attack power. There are three
levels of charge and up to five rounds can be fired.

name: Charge Shot II
short:
Can fire up to ten charged
Normal S Lv1 rounds with
less recoil than in Tier I.
full:
In Tier II, there are three levels of
charge, and up to ten rounds can
be fired. Recoil is also less severe.

name: Charge Shot III
short:
Can fire up to ten charged
Normal S Lv1 rounds with
less recoil than in Tier II.
full:
In Tier III, there are three levels of
charge and up to ten rounds can
be fired. Recoil is further reduced.

name: Sakura Slash I
short:
Two sweeping slashes that,
if they connect, spawn after-
strikes and raise the Spirit Gauge.
full:
A quick jump backwards gives momentum
to two sweeping slashes. If the attack
connects, the wounds inflicted will open
in a spray of blood after a brief pause,
and the Spirit Gauge will rise one level.

name: Sakura Slash II
short:
Two sweeping slashes that,
if they connect, spawn after-
strikes and raise the Spirit Gauge.
full:
Tier II's sweeping slashes are more
powerful than in Tier I.

name: Sakura Slash III
short:
Two sweeping slashes that,
if they connect, spawn after-
strikes and raise the Spirit Gauge.
full:
Tier III features fierce slashes that
are more powerful than in Tier II.

name: Unhinged Spirit I
short:
Grants a brief burst of Spirit,
filling the Spirit Gauge and
keeping it from draining.
full:
Concentrates your spiritual power for a
burst of Spirit as you swing your blade.
Temporarily fills your Spirit Gauge to Max,
allowing you to use Spirit Blade attacks
without depleting the gauge.

name: Unhinged Spirit II
short:
Grants a burst of Spirit,
filling the Spirit Gauge and
keeping it from draining.
full:
In Tier II, the Spirit Gauge stays
at Max for a longer period of time.

name: Unhinged Spirit III
short:
A large burst of Spirit, filling
the Spirit Gauge and keeping it
from draining for a while.
full:
In Tier III, the Spirit Gauge stays at
Max for an even longer period of
time than in Tier II.

name: Critical Juncture I
short:
Clears your mind, allowing
you to parry an attack and
execute a fierce counter.
full:
Passed on to the Guild from the Far East,
this Hunter Art calms you and clears
your mind, allowing you to parry a
monster's attack. Upon a successful
parry, you unleash a deadly counterattack.

name: Critical Juncture II
short:
Clears your mind, allowing
you to parry an attack and
execute a fierce counter.
full:
Tier II dips you into an even clearer
state of mind, allowing you to perform
an even stronger counterattack
upon a successful parry.

name: Critical Juncture III
short:
Clears your mind, allowing
you to parry an attack and
execute a fierce counter.
full:
Tier III allows you to completely clear
your mind, letting you unleash a
devastating counterattack upon
a successful parry.

name: Devouring Demon I
short:
Temporarily raises your Attack
by sharpening the mind, but places
a great burden upon the body.
full:
Grants you a temporary boost in Attack power.
During this time, your Health will continue to drain,
but can be restored by landing hits.
~The demon's price for this pact is vitality itself; you
must hunt, lest the demon exact its price from you.~

name: Devouring Demon II
short:
Temporarily raises your Attack
by sharpening the mind, but places
a great burden upon the body.
full:
Tier II forges a deeper demonic pact,
draining life at an even faster rate in
exchange for ferocious power.
~The demon's price for this pact is vitality itself; you
must hunt, lest the demon turn its eye on you.~

unlock.title: Sky Tribe: Savior of the Skyway

name: Devouring Demon III
short:
Temporarily raises your Attack
by sharpening the mind, but places
a great burden upon the body.
full:
Tier III forges an even deeper demonic
pact, draining life rapidly in exchange
for tremendous power.
~The demon's price for this pact is vitality itself; you
must hunt, lest the demon consume you entirely.~

name: Trance Slash I
short:
Unleashes a string of axe
and sword attacks, finishing
with a discharge.
full:
You switch repeatedly from axe to sword,
delivering a furious combo ending with
an Element Discharge. You can reorient
yourself mid-combo, and you also retain
the effects of Demon Riot, if it is active.

name: Trance Slash II
short:
Unleashes an heavy barrage
of axe and sword attacks,
finishing with a discharge.
full:
In Tier II, each attack in the combo
is stronger than in Tier I.

name: Trance Slash III
short:
Unleashes a ferocious storm
of axe and sword attacks,
finishing with a discharge.
full:
In Tier III, each attack in the combo
does even fiercer damage than
in Tier II.

name: Demon Riot I
short:
Bolsters Sword Mode attack
strength, but the Switch
Gauge depletes over time.
full:
Takes the elemental energy within a
Switch Axe and rather than unleashing it,
keeps it sealed and pent up to a dangerous
degree. Sword Mode attacks are stronger,
but the Switch Gauge depletes over time.

name: Demon Riot II
short:
Bolsters Sword Mode attack
strength, but the Switch
Gauge depletes over time.
full:
In Tier II, Sword Mode attacks are
even stronger, and the effect lasts
longer, though the Switch Gauge
still depletes over time.

name: Demon Riot III
short:
Bolsters Sword Mode attack
strength, but the Switch
Gauge depletes over time.
full:
In Tier III, Sword Mode attacks are
strongest, though the effect doesn't
last as long as in Tier II. The Switch
Gauge still depletes over time.

name: Energy Charge I
short:
Reloads the internal Phial,
finishing with a horizontal
sweep of the sword.
full:
An Art invented by an eccentric Hunter
looking for a way to quickly Reload. It
allows for a fast Reload of the Switch
Axe's Phial in either Mode, finishing with
a horizontal swipe in Sword Mode.

name: Energy Charge II
short:
Reloads the internal Phial,
finishing with a horizontal
sweep of the sword.
full:
In addition to the quick Reload and
horizontal sweep, Tier II also slightly
raises your Affinity.

name: Energy Charge III
short:
Reloads the internal Phial
and raises Affinity, finishing
with a horizontal sword sweep.
full:
In addition to the quick Reload and
horizontal sweep, Tier II substantially
raises your Affinity.

name: Tempest Axe I
short:
Powers up Axe Mode for a short
time and speeds up movement.
Some axe attacks are also stronger.
full:
By masterfully gauging the axe's weight,
this Hunter Art allows a lightness of motion
that borders on the impossible. It also adds
a vertical slash to your repertoire, which
utilizes the rapid swing momentum.

name: Tempest Axe II
short:
Powers up Axe Mode for a short
time and speeds up movement.
Some axe attacks are also stronger.
full:
In Tier II, the duration of the effects
is longer than in Tier I.

name: Tempest Axe III
short:
Powers up Axe Mode for a short
time and speeds up movement.
Some axe attacks are also stronger.
full:
In Tier III, the duration of the effects
is even longer than in Tier II.

name: Dragon Blast I
short:
Spews a fearsome swirling
vortex of explosive hellfire.
full:
Expels a superhot vortex of twisting
flames. Takes time to charge, but the
explosive payoff is well worth it.

name: Dragon Blast II
short:
Spews a fearsome swirling
vortex of explosive hellfire.
full:
In Tier II, the effects are more potent
and it takes less time to charge than
in Tier I.

name: Dragon Blast III
short:
Spews a fearsome swirling
vortex of explosive hellfire.
full:
In Tier III, the effects are more potent
and it takes less time to charge than
in Tier II.

name: Blast Dash I
short:
Shells propel you forward to
close in on foes. Can use
Overhead Smash after landing.
full:
An innovative Art that uses shelling recoil
to propel you forward, allowing you to close
any gaps between you and your target.
Capable of finishing with an Overhead
Smash after you land.

name: Blast Dash II
short:
Shells propel you forward to
close in on foes. Can use
Overhead Smash after landing.
full:
Tier II is capable of propelling you farther
ahead than Tier I.

name: Blast Dash III
short:
Shells propel you forward to
close in on foes. Can use
Overhead Smash in midair.
full:
Tier III is capable of propelling you farther
ahead than Tier II, as well as allowing you
to finish with an Overhead Smash in midair.

name: Dragon Breath I
short:
Builds up and maintains the
Heat Gauge significantly,
strengthening shelling.
full:
Quickly builds up heat within using the
Wyvern's Fire mechanism. Once activated,
the Heat Gauge remains high, making shelling
attacks stronger, though it's not a method
craftsmen are likely to be thrilled about.

name: Dragon Breath II
short:
Builds up and maintains
Heat Gauge significantly,
strengthening shelling.
full:
In Tier II, the heat built up in the
Gunlance lasts longer than
in Tier I.

name: Dragon Breath III
short:
Builds up and maintains
Heat Gauge significantly,
strengthening shelling.
full:
In Tier III, the heat built up in the
Gunlance lasts longer than
in Tier II.

name: AA Flare I
short:
Knock out aerial targets with
Burst Fire, following up with
Wyvern's Fire if possible.
full:
Combats aerial targets with great firepower
using the installed anti-air module. Begins
by unloading a full volley into the air, and
quickly follows up with Wyvern's Fire if
the Gunlance hasn't Overheated.

name: AA Flare II
short:
Knock out aerial targets with
Burst Fire, following up with
Wyvern's Fire if ready.
full:
In Tier II, you lose less of your Heat Gauge
from the Wyvern's Fire Overheat.

name: AA Flare III
short:
Knock out aerial targets with
Burst Fire, following up with
Wyvern's Fire if ready.
full:
In Tier III, you lose even less of your Heat Gauge
from the Wyvern's Fire Overheat.

name: Triple Volley I
short:
Fires three volleys of arrows,
dealing heavy damage. The
last one is especially powerful.
full:
Fire off arrows in groups of three,
with the final shot being the strongest.
Fires in the direction you were facing
upon activation.

name: Triple Volley II
short:
Fires a volley of three arrows,
dealing heavy damage. The
last one is especially powerful.
full:
In Tier II, the final shot takes
longer to fire, yet is stronger
than in Tier I.

name: Triple Volley III
short:
Fires a volley of three arrows,
dealing heavy damage. The
last one is especially powerful.
full:
In Tier III, the final shot takes
longer to fire, yet is stronger
than in Tier II.

name: Haste Rain I
short:
Once activated, speeds up
movement and charge rate
for a set period of time.
full:
A revolutionary technique that fires
an arrow above your head that
showers you with a special stimulant.
Temporarily raises movement and
charge speed.

name: Haste Rain II
short:
Temporarily raises movement
and charge speed for a set
period of time.
full:
In Tier II, the effect from the
stimulant lasts longer than
in Tier I.

name: Haste Rain III
short:
Temporarily raises movement
and charge speed for a set
period of time.
full:
In Tier III, the effect from the
stimulant lasts longer than
in Tier II.

name: Blade Wire I
short:
Steel wire ties arrows of any
charge together to deal cutting
damage. Cannot apply coatings.
full:
Binds two arrows together with wire to create
a flying blade when fired. All non-Arc Shot
and Power Shot charged arrows are swapped
temporarily for cutting wire. Cannot be
coated, but can sever a monster's tail.

name: Blade Wire II
short:
Steel wire ties arrows of any
charge together to deal cutting
damage. Cannot apply coatings.
full:
In Tier II, all non-Arc Shot and Power Shot
charged arrows are swapped for cutting
wire for a longer period than Tier I.

unlock.title: A Plesioth in the Misty Peaks

name: Blade Wire III
short:
Steel wire ties arrows of any
charge together to deal cutting
damage. Cannot apply coatings.
full:
In Tier III, all non-Arc Shot and Power Shot
charged arrows are swapped for cutting
wire for a longer period than Tier II.

name: Tactical Retreat I
short:
A dodge coupled with a backwards
shot, combining offense and defense.
The shot can be charged mid-dodge.
full:
This dual-purpose Art lets you dodge while
drawing the bowstring and shooting behind you.
Hold down the Charged Attack button to keep
the bowstring drawn and save your attack for
later. The shot is unaffected by distance.

name: Tactical Retreat II
short:
A dodge coupled with a backwards
shot, combining offense and defense.
The shot can be charged mid-dodge.
full:
In Tier II you'll have the added
chance of dealing critical hits.

name: Tactical Retreat III
short:
A dodge coupled with a backwards
shot, combining offense and defense.
The shot can be charged mid-dodge.
full:
In Tier III you'll be able to charge
your shot to a higher level, and it
will be easier to land critical hits.

name: Blood Wind I
short:
Spins you forward as you
slash at your target. Can
reorient two times.
full:
With Dual Blades twirling, advance
to slice through targets. You can
change direction during execution
twice.

name: Blood Wind II
short:
Spins you forward as you
slash at your target. Can
reorient three times.
full:
In Tier II, you're able to change
direction three times.

name: Blood Wind III
short:
Spins you forward as you
slash at your target. Can
reorient four times.
full:
In Tier III, you're able to change
direction four times and the attack
is more powerful than Tier II.

name: Aerial Slam I
short:
Leap off a ledge to perform a
spinning attack and a
follow-up aerial drop attack.
full:
Rush off a ledge to perform a spinning
attack. If the hit lands, you can
follow up with an aerial drop attack.

name: Aerial Slam II
short:
Leap off a ledge to perform a
spinning attack and a
follow-up aerial drop attack.
full:
In Tier II, landing a hit allows
you to fly higher in the air for
a follow-up drop attack.

name: Aerial Slam III
short:
Leap off a ledge to perform a
spinning attack and a
follow-up aerial drop attack.
full:
In Tier III, landing a hit allows
you to fly even higher in the air
for a follow-up drop attack.

name: Wolf's Maw I
short:
A fearsome animalistic
attack where you deal
two hits in one swing.
full:
A technique that has you succumb
to a raw, animalistic rage, allowing you
to deal two hits with a single swing.
Requires the utmost trust in your skills.

name: Wolf's Maw II
short:
A fearsome animalistic
attack where you deal
two hits in one swing.
full:
Tier II allows you to channel
this rage for a longer period
of time than Tier I.

name: Wolf's Maw III
short:
A fearsome animalistic
attack where you deal
two hits in one swing.
full:
Tier III allows you to channel
this rage for a longer period
of time than Tier II.

name: Spiral Slice I
short:
Spring forth in a whirl of blades,
dealing major damage to a
monster's soft parts.
full:
Leap forward in a corkscrew motion, blades
ripping at a monster's soft parts. It takes
more than technique and a well-trained body
to perform this Hunter Art.

name: Spiral Slice II
short:
Spring forth in a whirl of blades,
dealing major damage to a
monster's soft parts.
full:
In Tier II you spin your body faster
to dig your blades deeper into
a monster's soft parts.

name: Spiral Slice III
short:
Spring forth in a whirl of blades,
dealing major damage to a
monster's soft parts.
full:
In Tier III you spin your body as fast
as possible to dig your blades deeper
into a monster's soft parts.

name: Euphony I
short:
Triggers the effects of all
playable Melodies at one time.
Effects apply only to yourself.
full:
Triggers the effects of all playable
Melodies. As this Art relies on a
unique music scale in order to work,
the effects bestowed from this Art
will only apply to you.

name: Euphony II
short:
Triggers the effects of all
playable Melodies at one time.
Effects apply only to yourself.
full:
In Tier II, the execution time is
faster than Tier I, however, effects
are still only applied to yourself.

name: Euphony III
short:
Triggers the effects of all
playable Melodies at one time.
Effects apply only to yourself.
full:
Tier III has a faster execution
time than Tier II, however, effects
are still only applied to yourself.

name: Sonic Smash I
short:
Perform a combo that ends
in a smashing blow that
sends out a shock wave.
full:
Perform a double-spin combo that
ends in a smashing blow, emitting
a soundwave. Ideal as a defensive
tactic, too.

name: Sonic Smash II
short:
Perform a combo that ends
in a smashing blow that
sends out a shock wave.
full:
Tier II ends in a more powerful
soundwave than Tier I.

name: Sonic Smash III
short:
Perform a combo that ends
in a smashing blow that
sends out a shock wave.
full:
Tier III gets an upgraded combo
and has a more powerful
soundwave than Tier II.

name: Harmonize I
short:
Temporarily doubles Notes,
even if an attack doesn't
connect.
full:
A new type of Melody that affects the
Hunting Horn itself, rather than the
hunter. Notes are doubled for a
limited time, even when an attack
misses.

name: Harmonize II
short:
Temporarily doubles Notes,
even if an attack doesn't
connect.
full:
In Tier II, the period in which
Notes are doubled lasts
longer than in Tier I.

name: Harmonize III
short:
Temporarily doubles Notes,
even if an attack doesn't
connect.
full:
In Tier III, the period in which
Notes are doubled lasts
even longer than in Tier II.

name: Invigoration I
short:
For a time, your Performances will
kick off with a dodge, with a small
window of invulnerability.
full:
Transform your entire performance with
the spirit of the hunt. While this Art is
active, your Performances and Encores
will begin with a quick dodge, with a small
window of invulnerability.

name: Invigoration II
short:
For a time, your Performances will
kick off with a dodge, with a small
window of invulnerability.
full:
In Tier II, the invigorating effect
lasts longer than in Tier I.

name: Invigoration III
short:
For a time, your Performances will
kick off with a dodge, with a small
window of invulnerability.
full:
In Tier III, the invigorating effect
lasts longer than in Tier II.

name: Extract Hunter I
short:
Hurls your Kinsect with lightning
speed to harvest three Extracts.
Extract effects are short.
full:
Hurls your Kinsect with lightning speed
towards a monster. The Kinsect will harvest
all three Extracts: Red, White, and
Orange. Note that the duration of
Extract effects is short for this Art.

name: Extract Hunter II
short:
Hurls your Kinsect with lightning
speed to harvest three Extracts.
Extract effects are short.
full:
In Tier II, Extract effects last
longer than Tier I, improving
ease of use.

name: Extract Hunter III
short:
Hurls your Kinsect with lightning
speed to harvest three Extracts.
Extract effects are short.
full:
In Tier III, Extract effects last
longer than Tier II, improving
ease of use.

name: Swarm I
short:
Summons a swarm of insects
that float around you, attacking
anything nearby.
full:
Summons a swarm of protective insects
that take position around you, attacking
any and all things that dare to get close
to you. Be careful using it around allies.

name: Swarm II
short:
Wraps you in a horde of
insects that attack any
perceived threats.
full:
In Tier II, the insect swarm glows
yellow and has a greater attack
power than in Tier I.

name: Swarm III
short:
Wraps you in a horde of
insects that attack any
perceived threats.
full:
In Tier III, the insect swarm glows
red and has a greater attack
power than in Tier II.

name: Bug Blow I
short:
Vaults after a combo attack
to do an Overhead Smash.
Stronger with Swarm active.
full:
Performs a vault after pulling off a combo
attack to unleash an Overhead Smash
from midair. Especially potent when used
in tandem with the Swarm Art, as the
insects are concentrated for a hard blow.

name: Bug Blow II
short:
Vaults after a combo attack
to do an Overhead Smash.
Stronger with Swarm active.
full:
Tier II has a higher jump height
than Tier I, allowing you to hit
hard-to-reach targets.

name: Bug Blow III
short:
Vaults after a combo attack
to do an Overhead Smash.
Stronger with Swarm active.
full:
Tier III has a higher jump height
than Tier II, allowing you to hit
hard-to-reach targets.

name: Bug Majeure I
short:
Awakens your Kinsect for a time,
and adds an additional spin to
your Kinsect Spin Attacks.
full:
A support art that calls forth a unique species
of bug to awaken your Kinsect. This symbiosis
grants more precise movement in exchange for
your Kinsect's stamina, and adds an additional
high-speed spin to your Kinsect Spin Attacks.

name: Bug Majeure II
short:
Awakens your Kinsect for a time,
and adds an additional spin to
your Kinsect Spin Attacks.
full:
In Tier II, an extended period of symbiosis
grants a longer lasting effect than in Tier I.

name: Bug Majeure III
short:
Awakens your Kinsect for a time,
and adds an additional spin to
your Kinsect Spin Attacks.
full:
In Tier III, an extended period of symbiosis
grants a longer lasting effect than in Tier II.

name: Energy Blade I
short:
Turns an Element Discharge
into a blade. Charge amount
affects length and power.
full:
Converts the energy outputted from an
Element Discharge into a blade of light.
The number of charged phials affects both
the length of the blade and its overall
power.

name: Energy Blade II
short:
Turns an Element Discharge
into a blade. Charge amount
affects length and power.
full:
In Tier II, the energy output from
the Element Discharge is higher
than in Tier I.

name: Energy Blade III
short:
Turns an Element Discharge
into a blade. Charge amount
affects length and power.
full:
In Tier III, the energy output from
the Element Discharge is higher
than in Tier II.

name: Limit Breaker I
short:
Temporarily raises the
overall charge limit from
five phials to seven.
full:
Raises the phial charge limit from
the standard five units to seven, giving
you more flexibility with moves that
rely on them.

name: Limit Breaker II
short:
Temporarily raises the
overall charge limit from
five phials to nine.
full:
Tier II raises the phial charge limit
from the standard five units to nine,
giving you more flexibility with moves
that rely on them.

name: Limit Breaker III
short:
Temporarily raises the
overall charge limit from
five phials to ten.
full:
Tier III raises the phial charge limit
from the standard five units to ten,
giving you more flexibility with moves
that rely on them.

name: Healing Phial I
short:
Swaps your gear for a healing
phial that restores your health
with a Roundslash.
full:
A Hunter Art that sees a Charge Blade gaining
healing functionality. The energy stored in your
phials is temporarily used to heal your Health,
which can be done by charging or with an
Elemental Boosted Roundslash.

name: Healing Phial II
short:
Swaps your gear for a healing
phial that can Roundslash you
and your allies back to Health.
full:
In Tier II, the energy stored in your
phials is temporarily used to heal your
Health, as well as that of any allies who
are very close by.

name: Healing Phial III
short:
Swaps your gear for a healing
phial that can Roundslash you
and your allies back to Health.
full:
In Tier III, the energy stored in your
phials is temporarily used to heal your
Health, as well as that of any allies who
are relatively close by.

name: Ripper Shield I
short:
Transforms your shield into a powerful
cutting disc, which also recovers
blade attack energy.
full:
The shield attaches to the blade to form a high-speed
cutting disc that mangles foes. The multi-stage shield
attack greatly boosts blade attack energy, then uses that
energy to replenish phials. Press the R Button to do a
Shield Charge.

name: Ripper Shield II
short:
Transforms your shield into a powerful
cutting disc, which also recovers
blade attack energy.
full:
Recovers more blade attack energy
than in Tier I.

name: Ripper Shield III
short:
Transforms your shield into a powerful
cutting disc, which also recovers
blade attack energy.
full:
Recovers more blade attack energy
than in Tier II.
